# Eric Desaulniers Appointed to Canada’s Strategic Exports Advisory Council


31 August 2026 -


[Matawinie](https://nmg.com/category/matawinie/) ,[Leadership](https://nmg.com/category/leadership/) ,[Investing](https://nmg.com/category/investing/) ,[Bécancour](https://nmg.com/category/becancour/)


## Providing Industry Perspectives in support of Canada’s long-term economic growth


As countries intensify efforts to secure strategic supply chains and strengthen their economic resilience, Canada is advancing initiatives to expand its presence in global markets and diversify its trade relationships.


Following the recent announcement by Minister of International Trade Maninder Sidhu, Eric Desaulniers, NMG’s Founder, President and CEO, has been appointed to Canada’s Strategic Exports Advisory Council, joining leaders from across the Canadian business community in providing industry perspectives to support Canada’s trade diversification efforts and the operations of the newly established Strategic Exports Office.


The Council brings together executives from leading Canadian organizations spanning critical sectors of the economy. Through this forum, members will contribute perspectives on international trade opportunities, market access, and the conditions required to help Canadian businesses compete and grow globally.


Committed to executing its ambition of building one of the first fully integrated natural graphite production platforms in the G7, NMG is looking forward to sharing the experience gained through its large-scale industrial projects, building long-term partnerships, and supporting the development of resilient North American and allied supply chains.


This appointment follows Eric’s recent[nomination to the Board of Directors of XXIX Metal Corp. (TSXV: XXIX)](https://xxix.ca/news/xxix-appoints-eric-desaulniers-to-board-of-directors/) and provides another opportunity to contribute to conversations shaping Canada’s long term economic growth, industrial competitiveness, and trade diversification objectives.


Read the Government of Canada’s announcement:[Minister Sidhu establishes Strategic Exports Office to strengthen Canada’s global competitiveness](https://www.canada.ca/en/global-affairs/news/2026/07/minister-sidhu-establishes-strategic-exports-office-to-strengthen-canadas-global-competitiveness.html)
